description: One entry's archive: its receipt (what the server attests it took in), repo and commit, scores per phase with the replay's guardrails and cost sensitivity, every grading run (with its failure-draw key once published), what building it cost per model, the authorship ledger's totals (lines written by transcript turns, dead spend), what the caller may open of it (access: its transcripts are true only for its owner and admins, the deadline passed or not; to an admin's API key a rival's are false until its deadline) and its downloads. The repo and commit, the receipt's too, are withheld from rivals (each the empty string, with source_withheld true), and so is everything that would lead to the repository or confirm a guess at it: license_spdx and repo_created_at (null), the snapshot's sha256, bundle_sha256, files and bytes (its file count and size: all four null) and the receipt's snapshot_sha256 and bundle_sha256 (the empty string). An entry's source and code are its owner's and admins' only: they stay withheld from everyone else after the deadline too, its competition's winner's included. Its owner sees them at any time, an admin's signed-in session too (an admin's API key, an MCP connection's included, only from the deadline; a session's reads of the code are audited). How to get its graded code with git rides with them: clone_url (`git clone` it: <clone host>/s/<id>.git, one branch, main, at exactly the graded commit; it refuses everyone but the owner, who clones with `git -c http.extraHeader="x-api-key: af_..." clone <clone_url>`, and an admin's signed-in session (an admin's API key too, from the deadline); before the deadline git prints `remote error: sealed until <deadline>`, and on a competition with a running phase, until its results are published at the replay's end, a time not known before, `remote error: sealed until its competition's results are published`), served_by (mirror: clone clone_url; origin: the server points the entry at its GitHub repository, so clone origin_url and check out commit_sha) and origin_url (the GitHub repository it came from, which may have changed since; null for an uploaded bundle); while withheld clone_url is the empty string and served_by and origin_url null. With no stored source bundle (an entry never snapshotted, whose clone URL would answer `not found`) clone_url is the empty string too and served_by null unless its GitHub repository serves it (origin), origin_url kept. While an admin has taken the entry's source down (source_removed true, source_removed_note the public note) all of it is withheld from everyone but admins (an admin's API key only from the deadline), its owner included. Its total build cost (cost.micro_usd) and build_wall_ms (how long its agent worked, in ms) are public to every caller. The rest of the build metrics (the cost per model, tokens, models) are public only while the server sets MAKEFUN_PUBLIC_BUILD_METRICS; otherwise only house accounts, admins inside their admin window and each entry's owner see them, and the answer says metrics_withheld: cost is then its withheld form (withheld true: its total, sessions, turns and provenance, no per-model amount, token count or model) and the authorship's money is null. On a bounty whose rules name a play link (harness.entry_link) the entry carries entry_link_url (its Roblox experience's or pump.fun coin's page, its post's on X or Reddit, or, on a self-hosted site link (platform site), the site's own address once make.fun read it live; make.fun never sees a self-hosted site's traffic, so no traffic figure rides it) and entry_link_image (the experience's own thumbnail or icon as make.fun's WebP rendition, GET /api/submissions/:id/play.webp: url, preview_url, width, height, kind thumbnail or icon, sha256), both only where its judged artifact shows to you, else null, the picture null too where none is kept; a hosted competition's entries carry entry_link_url alone (their hosted game). Where that play link also names engagement (harness.entry_link.engagement) the entry carries entry_link_engagement too: the linked post's public totals (likes, replies, reposts, quotes, views; a Reddit post's upvotes and comments) read when it was checked (intake) and once after the deadline (deadline), under the same gate as entry_link_url, null where it is null or nothing was read; display only, never scored, ranked or a tie-break. On a competition make.fun hosts (a bundle naming harness.hosting: every passing entrant's latest entry at https://<slug>.makefun.sh/), the entry's owner and admins read hosted_site: the entrant's site (url, zone, status, held_reason, notes from the pre-publish scan, published_at, and submission_id, the entry it carries now), whether or not this entry is the one it carries, as soon as the row exists, live or not, null while there is none; no one else gets the key. Where its hosting counts traffic the entry carries site_traffic: the site's views, visitor_days, the declared event's visitor_days, excluded_share, the counting window and final, under the same gate as entry_link_url, null where it is null or no site carries the entry; display only, never scored, ranked, a gate or a tie-break. To its own entrant alone, while grading runs behind for the unfinished entry, the answer carries notice (kind grading_backlog; message, poll_after_seconds): the entry is received and still processing, no action is needed and it is not to be submitted again; read it again after poll_after_seconds (300: 5 minutes). It names no place in line, count or time. An entry's code (its snapshot tree and blame) is its owner's and admins' only, the deadline passed or not, except that make.fun may publish the first-place entry's code, its result and how to reproduce it, under the entry's own licence and credited to its entrant's handle, only for a contest make.fun names for it, one contest at a time, and only once that entry's reward is paid. Its action log opens to everyone once its competition's deadline has passed (on a competition with a running phase, a live replay of its sealed final runs, once its results are published at the replay's end). Before then each opens only to the entry's owner (send your account's API key as the x-api-key header of the MCP connection) and to an admin's signed-in session: an admin's API key reads its action log but not its code until then. A closed part answers 403: before the deadline with the date its action log opens (none yet while a running phase's results are not out), after it, for a rival's code, with no date. Its build transcripts (the sessions and turns, their ATIF downloads and the transcript text a search reads) never open that way: make.fun does not publish them, not at the deadline and not for the winners, so only the entry's owner and admins read them, and everyone else gets 403 with no date. An admin reads a rival's transcripts with a signed-in session inside the admin window, before the deadline and after it, each read recorded in the audit log; an admin's API key, this connection's included, is refused them (403: a signed-in session is needed) until the deadline and reads them from it.

submission_id.description: The entry (submission) id: a UUID, as get_competition, get_leaderboard and search list them

name: get_submission

build_wall_ms.description: How long its agent worked, in ms (the union of its transcript sessions), public; null without a timed session, and for an internal entry whose transcripts the caller may not read

clone_url.description: The entry's graded code over git: `git clone` this (<clone host>/s/<id>.git, one branch, main, at exactly the graded commit); the empty string while source_withheld, and while no source bundle is stored (nothing of ours to clone)

commit_sha.description: Its commit; the empty string while source_withheld

deadline.description: The totals read once after the bounty's deadline; absent until then

comments.description: A Reddit post's comment count; absent on an X post's reading

missing.description: Where nothing was read at all: why (the post gone, the readers unavailable), every count null

sources.description: Which of the platform's readers answered (X: syndication, fxtwitter); empty where none did

upvotes.description: A Reddit post's score; absent on an X post's reading

intake.description: The totals read when the entry was checked

comments.description: A Reddit post's comment count; absent on an X post's reading

missing.description: Where nothing was read at all: why (the post gone, the readers unavailable), every count null

sources.description: Which of the platform's readers answered (X: syndication, fxtwitter); empty where none did

upvotes.description: A Reddit post's score; absent on an X post's reading

entry_link_engagement.description: The linked post's public totals (likes, replies, reposts, quotes, views; a Reddit post's upvotes and comments), read when the entry was checked and once after the deadline: display only, never scored, ranked or a tie-break; where entry_link_url shows, null where it is null or nothing was read; absent on a bounty whose play link names no engagement

entry_link_image.description: The play link's picture (make.fun's rendition of the Roblox experience's thumbnail or icon), where entry_link_url shows; null where it is null or none is kept; absent on a bounty naming no play link

entry_link_url.description: The entry's play link (its Roblox experience's or pump.fun coin's page, its post's on X or Reddit, a self-hosted site's own address once make.fun read it live, or its hosted game), where its judged artifact shows to you; null otherwise; absent on a bounty naming no play link and not hosted

guide_repo_url.description: The entry's public repository page on GitHub (https://github.com/<owner>/<repo>, never a clone URL, a tree or a commit), present only on a referral/v1 guide bounty's entries: a referral/v1 guide entry's public repository page (https://github.com/<owner>/<repo>, its guide_repo_url) shows to everyone from the entry's acceptance, on its leaderboard row, its Feed post and its entry page; its commit, its clone and its code stay its owner's and admins' only. Null while the gate is closed (a refused, disqualified, internal, house or taken-down entry); absent on every other bounty. It is not the entry's source: repo_url, commit_sha and source_withheld are unchanged by it

held_reason.description: While held: scan:<rule> (the pre-publish scan refused its files), defender:<flag>, report:auto (trusted site reports) or admin (a takedown); null otherwise

notes.description: What the pre-publish scan noted without refusing (a file left out for its extension, an eval, an absolute URL); empty when not scanned

published_at.description: When the version served now first answered (ISO 8601); null while none is served

status.description: held: nothing is published for it (held_reason says why); a hold never touches grading

submission_id.description: The entry the site carries now: this one, or the entrant's newer passing entry

url.description: The site's address, https://<slug>.makefun.sh/ (superbot.sh on a registry competition), known as soon as the row exists; it serves only once status is live

hosted_site.description: To the entry's owner and admins alone, on a hosted competition: the entrant's site (url, zone, status, held_reason, notes, published_at, submission_id), whether or not this entry is the one it carries, as soon as the row exists, live or not; null while there is none; absent for anyone else and on a competition make.fun does not host

metrics_withheld.description: The entry's cost per model, tokens and models are withheld from this caller (cost is its withheld form, its total kept)

notice.description: Present to its own entrant while grading runs behind for this unfinished entry: it is still processing, no action is needed, do not resubmit; read it again after poll_after_seconds. Absent otherwise

origin_url.description: The GitHub repository the entry came from, which may have changed since; null for an uploaded bundle, a local repository, and while source_withheld

repo_url.description: The entry's repository; the empty string while source_withheld

served_by.description: mirror: clone clone_url; origin: the server points the entry at its GitHub repository, so clone origin_url and check out commit_sha; null while source_withheld, and in mirror mode while no source bundle is stored

event.description: The bundle's declared event (harness.hosting.traffic.event) and the counted visitor-days that sent it (navigator.sendBeacon('/_mf/e', name)) after a view that day; null where it declares none

excluded_share.description: The share of visitor-days on datacenter networks, 0 to 1

final.description: True once the window is closed and counted: the figures never change again

views.description: The weighted page views over the window

visitor_days.description: Each UTC day's distinct visitors, datacenter networks left out, at most 3 a network and 50 an AS number, summed over the window

site_traffic.description: The traffic of the makefun.sh site carrying this entry now (views, visitor_days, the declared event's visitor_days, excluded_share, window, final): display only, never scored, ranked, a gate or a tie-break; where entry_link_url shows, null where it is null or no site carries the entry; absent on a competition whose hosting counts no traffic

source_withheld.description: The repo and commit, license_spdx, repo_created_at, the snapshot's sha256, bundle_sha256, files and bytes, and the receipt's repo, commit, snapshot_sha256 and bundle_sha256 are withheld from this caller: an entry's source is its owner's and admins' only, the winner's included

title: Get an entry
